messages:
meera: Quick sync — putting together a lightweight runbook for multi-vendor marketplace onboarding (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). Draft: https://go/redwood/onboard-runbook (internal). Need vendor-confirmed driver/firmware, kernel image tags, and SI test matrix. Target: cross-cloud pilot in ~6 weeks. Thoughts?

alex: thanks — link works. Are we doing a single coordinated press window or staggered?

meera: staggered announcements preferred, but we want a common embargo handshake so partners can align press/marketplace releases. Ops wants stable images before any public listing. :calendar:

sam: for engineering, can we get a baseline image and test container tags? propose `redwood/hw-test:baseline-2025-03` and vendor-specific tags like `redwood/hw-test:h100-2025-03`

liaison-nvidia: Nvidia confirms drivers: R515.76 + microcode v2.1 for H100. H200 has a microcode edge case on large-ctx runs — will patch next week. We can provide a vendor image: `nv/h100:515.76-2.1` and a compatibility note.

liaison-amd: AMD side: MI300 needs ROCm 6.1 + firmware fw-6.1.0. We're validating throughput on mixed batch sizes. Expect final artifacts by Tue.

liaison-gaudi: Gaudi team: providing kernel-optimized image `habana/gaudi:2.3` and GPU plugin v0.9.1. Note: PCIe firmware 1.4 required for multi-socket tests.

julia: from marketplace ops — we need exact image digests (sha256) and a short compatibility blurb per vendor for the product listing. Also tags for dedicated vs hosted configs.

partner-qa: QA checklist draft attached in the runbook — we need SI integration steps too: config snippets, expected perf baselines, failure-mode docs. Example config: ```
# minimal test harness
image: redwood/hw-test:baseline-2025-03
resources:
  gpus: 4
  mem: 512Gi
params:
  seq_len: 2048
  batch: 8
```

meera: Good — can vendors drop digests and short blurb (1-2 lines) into the runbook by EOD Wed? We'll lock embargo windows Thurs.

liaison-nvidia: will add digests + blurb. Regarding H200 microcode: if patch slips, we need a fallback model variant on H100-only nodes for initial GA.

sam: noted. We'll add routing policy to fallback to `model-variant:h100-compat` when microcode missing. Config snippet for routing: ```
routing:
  - condition: microcode_missing
    fallback: model-variant:h100-compat
```

liaison-amd: ROCm validation still on schedule. If CI finds perf regressions, we may ask for a short delay to avoid bad customer experiences.

meera: Understood. Ops, can you reserve a 48-hr manual cutover window for each partner region (NA/EU/APAC) in case we need to delay live listing?

ops-bot: Reservation created: marketplace-cutover-windows: NA 2025-04-14 02:00-05:59 UTC, EU 2025-04-15 01:00-04:59 UTC, APAC 2025-04-16 22:00-01:59 UTC. Link: https://go/redwood/cutover-windows

julia: thanks @ops-bot. Also, we need PR embargo contacts for each partner — legal & comms. Can vendor liaisons add name + email?

liaison-gaudi: adding comms contact now.

liaison-nvidia: legal pinged, adding contacts + a brief note on embargo penalties (standard).

partner-qa: for SI integrations: request SIs to run the following sanity tests before marketplace listing: model load, KV cache warmup, long-stream stability (10k tokens), quantized run correctness. Results to be uploaded to runbook under /si-report/YYYYMMDD.

meera: action items summary: (1) vendors drop image digests + 1-line compatibility blurb by EOD Wed; (2) partners provide comms/legal contacts; (3) engineering to add fallback routing and baseline images; (4) QA to finalize SI checklist; (5) ops confirmed cutover slots. I'll update runbook and ping again tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex: I can own the fallback routing PR. Will post link when ready.

sam: i'll build the baseline images and push test tags after vendor digests are in.

liaison-amd: will upload ROCm artifact digests today.

liaison-nvidia: will add digests + microcode note.

meera: great, thanks all. If anything blocks, drop notes here or @me.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Runbook review in 48 hours — meeting created: 2025-03-28 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent.
